data.narrative:
Reflection AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Misha Laskin and Ioannis Antonoglou. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), with proximate stage and sector peers including Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

The Stage-Progression method is not applicable. The supplied post-money valuation of $25.0B implies a $50.0B Series B value, which exceeds the company's total raised capital of $2.0B by more than 20x—indicating the initial data point is unreliable. The Peer-Median method is applicable. The median valuation across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers stands at $3.2B, with a range of $2.0B to $5.6B. This peer set—Physical Intelligence at $5.6B (Series B), Black Forest Labs at $3.2B (Series B), and Field AI at $2.0B (Series B)—provides the primary triangulation anchor.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.8B to $3.7B, centered on the peer median of $3.2B. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size (one applicable method across three direct comparables) and stage heterogeneity in the peer set, where most comps are Series B rather than Series A. The discrepancy between the supplied $25.0B figure and peer-derived estimates warrants clarification on data provenance before final conclusion.
